svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How to open an unverified app (My.app) on macOS
svg.desc: Animated tutorial: open My.app and get the "Not Opened" warning, click Done, open Apple menu, System Settings, Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway, confirm Open Anyway, enter the administrator password, and My.app opens.
